scenario_basis: Illustrative Medicare-relative commercial payment paths; policy assumptions, not estimates of expected or adequate prices.

scenarios.rationale: Modest convergence; still requires provider-class testing.
Negotiation anchor near the boundary below which several states' case-mix-adjusted averages already operated in 2022.
Stress test only; not supported as a universal target.
Small convergence compatible with an initial access-monitoring phase.
Moderate scenario inside the observed state-average range; not a claim of adequate payment.
Stress test requiring specialty, primary-care, safety-net, geographic, and participation protections.

required_segmentation: site of care and facility fee

shared_gates: Use current commercial allowed spending at the repriced claim or service-line grain.
Apply targets only to the matched commercial population and covered services.
Model volume, coding, site-of-care, network, and consolidation responses.
Add transition, administration, monitoring, and enforcement costs.
Report gross payment change separately from payer, premium, household, employer, and federal fiscal effects.
Stop or revise a scenario when an access, quality, solvency, or participation floor fails.
next_gate: Attach a current commercial allowed-spending base by service/provider class and run each scenario through adequacy, behavioral, transition-cost, incidence, access, and quality models.
